findings.issue: Lines 168–180 prove a general, reusable fact — a nonzero real polynomial is not a.e. zero on `Icc a b` with `a < b` — inline, and close it with a brittle five-lemma rewrite chain `Filter.eventually_false_iff_eq_bot, ae_eq_bot, Measure.restrict_eq_zero, Real.volume_Icc, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero`.

findings.evidence: Lines 71–72, 119–120, 121–122 are character-for-character the same proof term modulo the function argument.
findings.fix: Factor one lemma, e.g. `theorem integrableOn_pow_mul (hf : IntegrableOn f (Icc a b)) (n : ℕ) : IntegrableOn (fun x => x ^ n * f x) (Icc a b)`, and use it at all three sites; it is also what a caller needs to discharge the hypothesis of the GPD-level theorem.

findings.issue: `Assumptions (Model.zero Flavor)` — a reusable fact about a public definition in `GPD.Ambiguity` — is proved inline as an anonymous structure with `rfl` on each field, bypassing the existing simp lemma `Model.zero_H` that the same proof uses at lines 165 and 179. No `Assumptions (Model.zero …)` lemma exists anywhere in the repo.

summary: Proofs compile and are mostly readable, but one transfer theorem closes entirely by undocumented unfolding of `mellinMomentGpd`, and two reusable facts (a nonzero polynomial is not a.e. zero on a nondegenerate `Icc`; `x^n * f` integrable on a compact interval) are buried inside proofs, one of them behind a five-lemma rewrite chain.
